new_libraries.name: HUSB238 Soldered
new_libraries.author: Soldered
new_libraries.sentence: Library for the HUSB238 USB-PD sink breakout
new_libraries.paragraph: Read negotiated PD voltage/current and request voltage switches over native I2C

new_libraries.name: SensorRoxoOBR
new_libraries.author: Wesley Oliveira <wesleycooliveira@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Facilita o uso do sensor de cor TCS34725 via multiplexador I2C para robôs da OBR.
new_libraries.paragraph: Desenvolvida para simplificar a programação de robôs de linha da OBR. Esta biblioteca gerencia o sensor TCS34725 integrado a um multiplexador I2C, automatizando a troca de canais, normalização de dados e calibração para a identificação direta de cores essenciais como verde, vermelho, preto e branco.

library.name: AERL C Framework
library.author: Applied Electronics and Robotics Laboratory LLP
library.sentence: A HAL framework that makes embedded and robotics code fast, simple, and reliable — built for beginners.
library.paragraph: Beta. One global object (AERL), no setup boilerplate: include it and use it. Non-blocking timing (glow/flash/glctrl), unified logging, run-once/run-N control, and UART/I2C/SPI helpers. Works right beside Arduino.h.

library.name: DeterministicESPAsyncWebServer
library.author: Douglas Quigg (dstroy0) <dquigg123@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Zero-heap, asynchronous multi-protocol network server for ESP32 with a fully deterministic memory footprint.
library.paragraph: Serves RFC 7230 HTTP/1.1 (routes matched in insertion order; the parser validates every request byte-by-byte and auto-sends 400/413/414/501 with no application code), WebSocket (RFC 6455), Server-Sent Events, Basic/Digest auth, static file serving, multipart, JSON, templating, and a middleware pipeline, plus opt-in HTTPS/TLS, SSH, Telnet, and SNMP (v1/v2c/v3). All buffers are statically sized at compile time and no heap is used after begin(); feature flags strip unused subsystems.
